name: Burón (Spain)
description: Green field with narrow purple and yellow stripes, crossed by a white cross edged purple set towards the hoist, charged at the crossing with the crowned municipal arms of Burón (a lion on white and a bridge above waves).
history: Municipal flag of Burón; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

cross edged purple set towards the hoist
